world.title: Trump says unsure if woman linked to Jensen Huang was a spy, confirms speaking to former Nvidia chief
world.summary: US President Donald Trump confirmed he spoke with Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang on Wednesday. He expressed uncertainty regarding the status of a Chinese businesswoman linked to Huang, questioning whether it had been established that she was a spy. The comments come amid ongoing discussions about potential espionage and the implications for US-China relations in the tech industry.

world.title: An Oklahoma homeowner hosted 141 guests during 36 short-term stays despite neighbourhood rules; after a lower appeals court lifted restrictions, the state Supreme Court restored the ban and upheld $8,
world.summary: An Oklahoma homeowner has been ordered to pay over $8,000 after the state Supreme Court reinstated a neighborhood ban on short-term rentals. This decision follows a lower appeals court lifting restrictions, allowing the homeowner to host 141 guests during 36 short-term stays. The ruling concludes a protracted legal dispute regarding property usage regulations in the area.

world.title: Indians top again: 9.3L get OECD citizenships in 5 years
world.summary: Indians have emerged as the leading group in acquiring citizenship in advanced economies, with approximately 9.25 lakh (925,000) Indian citizens obtaining nationality from OECD member countries between 2020 and 2024. This trend highlights the significant movement of Indians seeking citizenship in developed nations, as reported in the 'International Migration Outlook' report, reflecting ongoing migration patterns and opportunities abroad.

business.title: Trump says unsure if woman linked to Jensen Huang was a spy, confirms speaking to former Nvidia chief
business.summary: US President Donald Trump confirmed he spoke with Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang on Wednesday. He expressed uncertainty regarding the status of a Chinese businesswoman associated with Huang, questioning whether it had been determined if she was a spy. The comments come amid ongoing discussions about national security and foreign influence in the tech industry.

business.title: Stock Market Today: All You Need To Know Before Going Into Trade On Nov 13
business.summary: The Indian stock market experienced minor gains on November 13, closing up 31.61 points, or 0.04%, amid a volatile session. Lower crude oil prices contributed to improved market sentiment, with significant buying observed in banking and financial sectors. Investors are advised to stay informed about stocks in the news and brokerage calls for effective trading strategies.

business.title: Top 25 Best-Selling Cars in October 2026: Wagon R Takes No. 1 Spot, Brezza Surges 86%, Seltos Grows 88%
business.summary: In October 2026, the Wagon R topped India's best-selling cars list with 23,747 units sold, an increase from 18,970 units the previous year. The Brezza surged to second place with an 86% growth, while the Kia Seltos experienced an 88% rise in sales. The rankings reflect a strong demand for practical and affordable vehicles in the market.

technology.title: Apple HomeView hands-on: Born to live on marble countertops
technology.summary: Apple's new HomeView smart display features facial recognition and Siri AI, providing personalized experiences for families. Set to launch on Friday, it is designed to be an attractive addition to home environments, particularly on marble countertops. Early tests indicate its potential to become a popular device in households, enhancing daily interactions through its advanced technology.

technology.title: OpenAI launches security products, tells orgs they’re doomed if they don’t use them
technology.summary: OpenAI has introduced two security products aimed at penetration testing and defense, emphasizing that organizations must adopt such tools to ensure their safety. Concurrently, a coalition of nonprofits has filed a lawsuit against major AI companies, citing concerns over AI-driven cyberattacks. OpenAI's announcement highlights the growing urgency for businesses to enhance their cybersecurity measures in the evolving digital landscape.

technology.title: Does The Affiliate Model Survive Checkout Inside AI Mode And Gemini? - Ask An SEO
technology.summary: Affiliate marketing remains relevant despite advancements in AI checkout and Google's Gemini. While shoppers may not click on affiliate links directly, enhanced tracking and improved program options help maintain referral credit and protect commissions. The discussion emphasizes the adaptation of the affiliate model in response to evolving technology, ensuring that marketers can still benefit from their promotional efforts.

sports.title: Marc Casado reveals why he requested no ‘fear clause’ in his loan from Barcelona to Deportivo
sports.summary: Marc Casado explained his decision to request no "fear clause" in his loan from Barcelona to Deportivo. He emphasized his desire to be available for every match, stating, “I want to play every game, or at least be available for every game.” Casado acknowledged that playing time ultimately depends on the coach's decision, but his availability is a priority.

sports.title: Jude Bellingham and Trent Alexander-Arnold feature in England’s win vs Croatia
sports.summary: England secured a 2-1 victory against Croatia, with Jude Bellingham and Trent Alexander-Arnold playing key roles in the match. The win contributes positively to England's performance in the ongoing competition. Fans are reminded to engage respectfully with each other and adhere to community guidelines, as any form of trolling or disrespectful behavior is prohibited.

sports.title: Czechia 0-2 Spain, Nations League: Álex Baena and Marc Pubill on target as La Roja escape with hard-fought win
sports.summary: Spain secured a 2-0 victory against Czechia in the Nations League, with goals from Álex Baena and Marc Pubill. The match proved challenging for La Roja, who aimed to finish at the top of their group. Barcelona players Pau Cubarsí, Fermín López, and Pedri participated, contributing to the team's performance in this crucial away match.

health.title: Evidence in Women With Cancer
health.summary: Mindfulness practices for insomnia have shown to improve sleep quality in many studies involving women with cancer. Despite these positive outcomes, the mechanisms behind this effectiveness remain unclear. Sleep disturbances are prevalent during and after cancer treatment, prompting many women to seek alternatives to medication. A recent scoping review analyzed 39 studies to explore existing evidence and identify gaps.

health.title: Congo Ebola outbreak still out of control after six months
health.summary: Médecins Sans Frontières reports that the Ebola outbreak in Congo remains uncontrolled after six months, with numerous cases likely undetected and ongoing hospital transmissions. Over 11,000 cases have been reported, highlighting significant challenges in response systems. The organization emphasizes the urgent need for improved measures to contain the virus, which continues to spread in various regions.

health.title: Most Men Should Get Prostate Cancer Screening After Age 50
health.summary: The American Cancer Society (ACS) recommends that most men begin prostate cancer screening at age 50. Research indicates that PSA screening can significantly lower the risk of death from prostate cancer. The updated guidelines emphasize the importance of monitoring prostate health for middle-aged men, aiming to enhance early detection and improve treatment outcomes for prostate cancer.

science.title: Crows make decisions twice as fast as humans, study finds
science.summary: A study from the University of Tübingen reveals that crows make visual decisions in an average of 235 milliseconds, which is twice as fast as humans and monkeys. The research highlights the birds' ability to accurately identify the direction of moving dots while processing information rapidly. This finding underscores the cognitive capabilities of crows in decision-making tasks.

science.title: Reusable molecular fabric could cut energy needed to separate industrial chemicals
science.summary: A team of scientists from UT Austin and Zhejiang University has developed a reusable molecular fabric that could significantly reduce the energy required to separate toxic chemicals from industrial processes, including those used in nylon, paint, and detergents. This innovative solution aims to enhance efficiency and practicality in chemical separation, with findings published in the journal Nature.

science.title: Chennai to witness planetary parade, Mars-Jupiter conjunction this weekend
science.summary: Chennai skywatchers can observe Mercury, Venus, Mars, and Jupiter together in the eastern sky before sunrise on November 14. A notable conjunction of Mars and Jupiter will occur on November 15-16, allowing viewers to see the two planets closely aligned. This celestial event will remain visible until December 2, providing an extended opportunity for observation.
